decks.name: Bay Area Birds: Sight and Sound
decks.description: See it and hear it: the everyday birds of Bay Area yards, parks, chaparral, and shoreline. Photo ID cards plus song and call mnemonics, with field marks and lookalike tips in the details.

decks.name: Bird ID: Eastern North America
decks.description: Identify 50 of the most common backyard, park, and roadside birds of eastern North America from photos. Details give the scientific name, key field marks, and how to separate lookalikes.

decks.name: Bird ID: Europe
decks.description: Identify 61 of Europe's best-known garden, park, farmland, and waterside birds from photos. Details give the scientific name, key field marks, and how to separate the classic confusion pairs.

decks.name: Bird ID: Southern United States
decks.description: Identify 55 birds that define the American South from photos: Gulf Coast wading birds, swamp warblers, pinewoods specialists, and South Texas tropicals. Pairs with the Eastern deck, with no repeats. Details give the scientific name, key field marks, and lookalike tips.

decks.name: Bird ID: Western North America
decks.description: Identify 55 signature birds of the American West from photos, from coastal chaparral to desert and mountain pine forest. Details give the scientific name, key field marks, and lookalike tips.

decks.name: Dog Breeds
decks.description: Name 65 dog breeds from photos, from the Labrador to the Basenji. Extras give each breed's giveaway field marks, its story, and how to split the classic confusion pairs: Husky vs Malamute, Whippet vs Greyhound, Malinois vs German Shepherd, Westie vs Scottie.

decks.name: Snake ID: Southern United States
decks.description: Identify 39 snakes of the American South from photos, from copperheads, cottonmouths, and rattlesnakes to the harmless water snakes, rat snakes, and coral snake mimics that get mistaken for them. Every card says venomous or harmless up front, then gives field marks and how to split the lookalikes.

decks.name: Tree and Plant ID: Southern United States
decks.description: Identify 52 trees, vines, and wildflowers of the American South from photos: live oak and Spanish moss, magnolia and bald cypress, longleaf pine, kudzu, and the carnivorous plants of Carolina bogs. Details give the scientific name, field marks, state-symbol trivia, and which ones are invasive.
